item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dbang drag bzlog 'khor lcags sdig
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par la/ sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri yi byang phyogs nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas spyan drangs pas/ slar bsod nams can stobs kyi pho brang rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbu rtse la shog ser bod yig du (tu) bsgyur ba grub pa'o//
